h1: Suphorn Grand Hotel Ang Thong — a Brand-New Hotel with Fresh, Clean Rooms in Town
intro: If you want a place to stay in Ang Thong that's a new build, with rooms that still feel fresh, and an easy in-town location — Suphorn Grand Hotel is the name guests keep mentioning right now. This 3-star hotel opened in late 2023 with 75 rooms in Mueang Ang Thong district, Ban It subdistrict. Rooms are newly fitted out and clean, parking is generous, breakfast is available, and rates start at about ฿900/night. The trade-off is that, being so new, a few things still need bedding in — like the hot water and a faint paint smell in places.

body.html: What sets Suphorn Grand Hotel apart from the older places to stay in Ang Thong is simply how new it is. The hotel only opened in late 2023, so the building is fresh and the furnishings show little wear. Several real guest reviews agree that the rooms look clean and modern, and feel like good value for the price because you get a near-new room without paying a premium.

Room types run from Superior Twin (two single beds) and Classic Superior to a King-bed Deluxe, plus Suite and Family rooms. Each room comes with air-con, a TV, fridge, mini-bar, hair dryer and bathroom toiletries. The room size is just right for an overnight stop or a break on a longer drive. Blackout curtains keep the room properly dark at night — a small touch that anyone sensitive to light will appreciate.

Another thing guests praise often is the spacious parking and the friendly staff. Drivers find it easy to park without circling for a space, and the staff get good marks for being welcoming and happy to point you to nearby restaurants and sights. The hotel sits in Mueang Ang Thong, close to the markets and food, with the town's restaurant streets and main attractions just a few minutes' drive away.
"A new hotel, clean rooms, comfy bed, really lovely staff, plenty of parking and a decent breakfast — genuinely good value for a stay in Ang Thong."

To be straight with you, the thing reviews flag most often on the downside is the hot water, which a staff member has to switch on for you first. Some guests found the bathroom water wasn't hot right away and had to call the front desk to activate the system, which costs a little time. If you run into this, the simplest fix is to ask at check-in so it's switched on before you need it.

The other thing to keep in mind, precisely because it's a new hotel, is a faint paint smell in some corridors and a slightly musty smell in a few rooms. A handful of reviews mention a light paint smell along the walkways, and some guests felt the bedding or air-con had a mild musty odour. On top of that, rooms don't come with free slippers — if you want a pair it's ฿40. These are the small details a new hotel tends to iron out over time, but worth knowing before you book.

Overall, Suphorn Grand Hotel scores 9.3 out of 10 on Trip.com from around 15 real reviews, which is high for Ang Thong. It's a sensible pick for anyone who wants a fresh, clean room in town, easy parking and a low rate. Prices start around ฿900 and rise with the season and room type into the low thousands for a Deluxe or Suite. If you can live with the hot-water quirk and the typical smells of a just-opened hotel, this place offers solid value for the price.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Suphorn Grand Hotel Ang Thong

faq.q: Where is Suphorn Grand Hotel in Ang Thong, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Suphorn Grand Hotel is at 42 Moo 11, Ban It, Mueang Ang Thong. It's in town, a few minutes' drive from the markets and restaurant streets. Wat Khun Inthapramun is about 20 minutes away by car and Wat Muang about 25 minutes.

faq.q: How much does Suphorn Grand Hotel cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿900/night for a Superior room. Options run from Superior Twin and Classic Superior to a King-bed Deluxe, plus Suite and Family rooms. Prices rise with the season and room type into the low thousands — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is Suphorn Grand Hotel really new, and are the rooms clean?
faq.a: Yes — the hotel only opened in late 2023, so the building and furnishings are still fresh, and many real reviews praise the rooms as clean and modern. Being new, there's still a faint paint smell in some corridors and a mild musty smell in a few rooms.

faq.q: Does Suphorn Grand Hotel have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes to both — there's free, spacious parking and breakfast is available. There's also an on-site restaurant and a meeting room. The generous parking is something real reviews mention often, making it handy for self-drivers.

faq.q: What's the deal with the hot water at Suphorn Grand Hotel?
faq.a: Some reviews note that the hot water has to be switched on by a staff member first before it works, so you can end up waiting. The easy fix is to ask the front desk to activate the hot-water system at check-in so it's ready when you want to shower.

faq.q: Who is Suphorn Grand Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a strong choice for anyone wanting a fresh, clean room in central Ang Thong at a low price, and for self-drivers who want easy parking. It suits an overnight stay to explore Ang Thong or a stop on a longer trip, as long as you can live with the hot-water quirk and the smells of a just-opened hotel.
